components.title: ASCII Binary Tide
components.brief: A structured binary wave with broad density bands and a protected optional reading zone. It is wrong if wave structure from analytic phase, not random noise or rain is absent.

components.title: ASCII Cellular Tape
components.brief: An elementary cellular automaton evolves row by row into a readable rule tape. It is wrong if rule and initial cells visibly change the evolving topology is absent.

components.title: ASCII Lissajous Scope
components.brief: A signal scope draws two coupled oscillator inputs as a measured glyph trace. It is wrong if frequency ratios change the trace, with useful phase landmarks is absent.

components.title: ASCII Loom Draft
components.brief: A compact editable warp and weft draft links a binary tie-up grid to its woven repeat. It is wrong if editing a tie-up cell changes the actual crossing pattern is absent.

components.title: ASCII Piano Roll
components.brief: A data-driven note roll aligns supplied pitches and durations on a cell grid. It is wrong if selection reads real note data; duration changes note width is absent.

components.title: ASCII Fretboard
components.brief: A pitch diagram maps supplied tuning and scale intervals onto a character fretboard. It is wrong if tuning and root transpose the actual pitch mapping is absent.

components.title: ASCII Tree Rings
components.brief: Supplied annual growth values form an irregular measured tree cross-section. It is wrong if growth values determine ring spacing, without decorative metadata chrome is absent.

components.title: ASCII Wave Tank
components.brief: A bounded shallow-wave field reflects impulses from walls and supplied obstacles. It is wrong if reflected wavefronts are caused by boundaries, unlike an unbounded wave background is absent.

components.title: Engraved Relief Image
components.brief: Image luminance becomes an engraved relief with a slow grazing light. It is wrong if light moves across fixed relief geometry; image preparation happens once is absent.

components.title: Lenticular Image
components.brief: Two supplied images share aligned lenticular strips controlled by viewing position. It is wrong if position reveals different source content, not merely a hue shift is absent.

components.title: Contour Wipe Image
components.brief: A progress-controlled wipe follows the luminance contours of a supplied image. It is wrong if progress traverses ordered contour levels and reaches a complete image is absent.

components.title: Pressure Print Image
components.brief: A supplied image is revealed through a local pressure-map impression. It is wrong if pressure changes the impression footprint and ink density in a visible way is absent.

components.title: Pixel Weft Image
components.brief: Image rows and columns interlace on alternating cell crossings as a slow woven reveal. It is wrong if interlaced source-image crossings remain distinct from the existing Louver bars is absent.

components.title: Edge Fold Image
components.brief: An image splits along one folded edge with a small controllable geometric opening. It is wrong if fold changes projection and revealed area; avoid a generic slide transition is absent.

components.title: Ternary Plot
components.brief: Three-part proportions map to a triangular chart with direct labels and glyph marks. It is wrong if values sum to a ternary position, with a useful accessible data table is absent.

components.title: Chord Diagram
components.brief: A weighted relation matrix maps to a ring of arc connections and direct endpoint labels. It is wrong if connection width and endpoints encode supplied relationship weights is absent.

components.title: Parallel Coordinate Plot
components.brief: Several numeric dimensions align on vertical axes to compare supplied records. It is wrong if each record traverses its actual normalized axis values is absent.

components.title: Horizon Chart
components.brief: Signed deviation is folded into compact measured density bands around a baseline. It is wrong if band density encodes magnitude and a distinct mark identifies negative values is absent.

components.title: Fan Chart
components.brief: A central time series and supplied uncertainty bounds form a restrained forecast fan. It is wrong if nested bounds encode supplied uncertainty instead of invented decoration is absent.

components.title: Dendrogram
components.brief: Weighted hierarchical data becomes an aligned branching tree with meaningful merge distances. It is wrong if branch lengths reflect supplied distances; labels remain usable on narrow hosts is absent.

components.title: Range Brush
components.brief: A two-handle interval brush lets a page choose a numeric window. It is wrong if native keyboard adjustment keeps lower and upper values ordered is absent.

components.title: Xy Pad
components.brief: A square two-axis input pairs a crosshair with accessible numeric controls. It is wrong if both axes emit useful controlled values by pointer and keyboard is absent.

components.title: Crop Window
components.brief: A normalized crop rectangle exposes four constrained edges over supplied child content. It is wrong if crop coordinates are usable outside the component and children stay owned by the page is absent.

components.title: Timecode Editor
components.brief: A compact grouped timecode input edits hours, minutes, seconds and frames. It is wrong if carrying and bounds remain correct across frame-rate settings is absent.

components.title: Penrose Tiles
components.brief: A bounded quasiperiodic rhombus patch produces a calm nonrepeating surface. It is wrong if use a real substitution structure rather than randomly rotating ordinary tiles is absent.

components.title: Cairo Pentagons
components.brief: Interlocking pentagons create a regular architectural tiling with readable seams. It is wrong if pentagons meet without gaps and remain a quiet page-owned surface is absent.

components.title: Dragon Fold
components.brief: A paper-folding dragon path generates a connected angular print pattern. It is wrong if the path follows a deterministic fold sequence, not random zigzags is absent.

components.title: Shadow Lattice
components.brief: A grazing light moves through a shallow lattice of occluders in measured dither tones. It is wrong if occlusion geometry casts coherent restrained shadows with a useful fallback is absent.

components.title: Split Flap Display
components.brief: A supplied short label changes through aligned split-flap glyph cells. It is wrong if only changed cells animate; the accessible text is always the supplied final value is absent.

components.title: Pendulum Chain
components.brief: A row of coupled pendulum traces exchanges phase slowly across fixed cells. It is wrong if coupling changes phase transfer, not just animation speed is absent.

components.title: Scroll Ruler
components.brief: A local scroll container exposes a measured tick ruler and readable progress position. It is wrong if progress follows the supplied host scroll extent without controlling the whole page is absent.

components.title: Spring Trace
components.brief: A damped response trace visualizes movement toward a supplied target value. It is wrong if parameters visibly change settling and overshoot; motion stops when settled is absent.

components.title: Perspective Maze
components.brief: A small supplied grid of walls becomes a perspective space with bounded navigation. It is wrong if grid data defines the world; navigation remains usable without the canvas is absent.

components.title: Geodesic Shell
components.brief: A faceted dome exposes selectable supplied panel records in a coherent 3D shell. It is wrong if selection is tied to a panel, distinct from a globe or generic orbit viewer is absent.

components.title: Strata Stack
components.brief: Supplied layer records form an exploded geological stack with a selected section. It is wrong if layer thickness and separation encode actual records; no page-scale dossier is absent.

components.title: Folded Atlas
components.brief: Supplied panel shapes unfold as an accordion atlas with one selected panel. It is wrong if the fold is actual panel geometry; content and selection remain accessible is absent.
